# Network Address

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NetworkAddress>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A network-layer address or locator expressed as a coordinate in a network reference frame — an IP address, MAC address, DNS name, URL, port number, or BGP autonomous-system number. The flat shortcut for the common case is [`gmeow:accessUrl`](../properties/gmeow-accessUrl.md) on a [`VirtualLocation`](gmeow-VirtualLocation.md); promote to [`NetworkAddress`](gmeow-NetworkAddress.md) when frame, provenance, confidence, or standpoint matters.
